notice.title: Instance notice
notice.intro: One short message under the header of every signed-in page, such as a maintenance window or “this is a demo”. It is your own text, so it isn’t translated.
notice.messageHint: Plain text on one line. {used, number} of {max, number} characters.
notice.linkHint: Starts with https://, or a single / for a page on this site. A link needs both its label and its address.
notice.toneHint: Warning is for something that needs care, such as data being reset.
notice.shownHint: Turning it off keeps the text, so you can turn it on again.
notice.previewEmpty: Write a message to see it here.
notice.previewHidden: Hidden: nobody sees it until you show it.

errors.message_empty: Write the message before showing the notice.
errors.message_too_long: Use up to {max, number} characters, on one line.
errors.label_missing: Add the label for the link.
errors.label_too_long: Use up to {max, number} characters for the label.
errors.address_missing: Add the address the label opens.
errors.address_invalid: Use an address that starts with https:// or a single /.
